title: AssetEntry
description: One usable 3D piece in the catalog. Coordinates/bbox are inlined here (not referenced from persistence) because asset-registry is a leaf that nothing upstream depends on. A `character` entry MUST declare its animations, so npc allowedModes can be validated against what the body can do. A `building` entry is a whole building in one file: it stands on a plot of its own size, so the city is laid out around it.

size.description: Axis-aligned bounding box [width, height, depth] in meters.

snapPoints.description: Modular attach points the grid solver connects pieces on.

anchor.description: Translation applied to the file when it is placed, so the piece ends up centred over its own footprint with its base at y=0. A file already written that way anchors at [0, 0, 0], which is the default.

doors.description: Only meaningful on a `building`: whether the file carries its own front door. `none` (the default) means the city builds a door on its face.

floors.description: Only meaningful on a `building`: how many storeys it stands, so the level behind its door can be built to match.

license.description: Explicit, commercial-use-clear license (e.g. CC0-1.0). Registration rejects a missing/unclear one.

animations.description: Clip names, required for character entries.
